description: Return the parent backtest document's status, error, interval, timestamps, elapsed time, and completed statistics without reading history/events. Use immediately after backtest_portfolio or before query_backtest_history so ERROR/PENDING/RUNNING states are explicit. Statistics include peakReservedCollateral and medianReservedCollateral — how much capital the book actually had on the line, which a percentage return does not say. Both read "not recorded" for a run made before collateral reporting existed; that is not zero, so do not report it as such. Zero research token cost.

backtest_id.description: Backtest ID (required). Must be owned by the calling MCP user.

name: query_backtest_status
